title: Determine Whether One Binary Search Tree is a Subtree of Another
problemStatement: Given two Binary Search Trees, determine whether the second tree occurs as a subtree of the first.
input: • The first line contains N₁. • The next N₁ lines describe the first BST. • The following line contains N₂. • The next N₂ lines describe the second BST.
output: • Print YES if the second tree is a subtree of the first; otherwise print NO.
